subject.title: Add sms.read command and SMS as a messaging channel

question: Should Android-device SMS become an OpenClaw messaging channel, and should it reuse the existing `sms` channel surface or live behind a separate Android-node-specific channel/plugin boundary?
rationale: The request grants read, receive, and send authority over carrier SMS while overlapping the current Twilio-owned `sms` channel and `channels.sms.*` config surface, so automation cannot safely choose the security and product boundary.

options.title: Split design first
options.body: Define a narrow Android `sms.read` command separately from Android-device SMS ingress/reply, then implement only after sender authorization, redaction, logging, and channel naming are approved.

options.title: Limit to read command
options.body: Accept only a dangerous-by-default Android `sms.read` invoke command and defer inbound/reply channel behavior until a separate channel design is approved.

options.title: Keep SMS hosted-provider only
options.body: Leave the official `sms` channel as Twilio-backed and route Android-device SMS channel work outside core unless a missing plugin/API seam is explicitly sponsored.

recommendation.title: Split design first
recommendation.body: Define a narrow Android `sms.read` command separately from Android-device SMS ingress/reply, then implement only after sender authorization, redaction, logging, and channel naming are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored the current Twilio-backed `sms` channel and has the clearest history signal for the channel/config boundary decision.
